LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Patrol_1: {PAWN} walked the border line, logged a quiet patrol, and turned back a couple of Legion scouts before they got too close.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Patrol_2: {PAWN} swept an old ranch for squatters, found none, and marked the water source as safe for the next caravan through.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Patrol_3: {PAWN} escorted a supply run without incident, dust in every crease of the uniform by the time camp came back into view.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Patrol_4: {PAWN} chased off a small band of raiders testing the perimeter and radioed in their last known heading.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Operation_1: {PAWN} cleared a raider camp squatting on a supply route and left a squad to hold the ground.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Operation_2: {PAWN} tracked down a missing patrol, found the wreckage, and brought back what could be salvaged along with a full report.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Operation_3: {PAWN} spent the operation mapping a stretch of contested highway, marking safe routes for the quartermaster's convoys.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Operation_4: {PAWN} came back with a busted rifle sling and a Legion banner as proof the outpost held.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_SpecOps_1: {PAWN} slipped past enemy lines alone where a squad would have drawn too much attention, and got the job done without a shot fired.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_SpecOps_2: {PAWN} ran the operation exactly to plan: in, secure the objective, out before anything organized a response.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_SpecOps_3: {PAWN} spent the better part of two weeks behind contested lines and came back with intel Camp McCarran will want to hear.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_SpecOps_4: {PAWN} didn't say much about what happened out there, just filed the report and asked for a debrief later.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Vanguard_1: {PAWN} pushed past the edge of any map the Republic has, charting ground for the survey teams to follow.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Vanguard_2: {PAWN} came back from beyond the frontier with a full report and coordinates worth sending an outpost to hold.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Vanguard_3: {PAWN} spent nearly two weeks out of contact and returned with word of something out there the President will want briefed.
LanguageData.FCP_Rank_Expedition_NCR_Vanguard_4: {PAWN} walked back into camp looking like the wasteland itself, carrying proof of what was found past the edge of the map.
